sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United will look to bounce back from their most recent loss when they host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach posted on X that this is a local derby and they seek to avenge a cup defeat to Alsager on penalties from the previous week. The Bach then face Cheadle Heath Nomads away on Saturday 10 October at 15:00, continuing their fixture schedule after sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second-placed with 20 points, travel to Dawley Town in their first-ever visit to Theatre of Jockeys on 3 October. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall on 3 October. Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community on 3 October in a derby clash, with both sides needing the points. Allscott Heath claim they're targeting five wins on the bounce as they travel to Crewe on 3 October. Cheadle Heath Nomads welcome Telford Town at home on 3 October. On 10 October, Bilston Town face Crewe at home, while Market Drayton Town host struggling Widnes Town. Barnton play Shawbury United on 3 October, and the two teams meet again on 10 October. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town on 3 October and host Telford Town on 10 October. Foley Meir face Bilston Town at home on 3 October. Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community midweek on 7 October before travelling to Allscott Heath on 10 October.
